visual.style: clean modern flat illustration: simple confident shapes, soft gradients, a calm limited palette of night blue, slate, warm sun yellow and sea green on paper white, clear and friendly, not photorealistic
visual.texture: smooth flat colour with a fine paper grain
visual.lighting: soft, even, natural light with gentle shadows and one clear focal point
visual.morph: The picture flows smoothly into the next: shapes reshape and slide into place and colours blend, with nothing flashing or cutting. The image stays flat and illustrated, never photographic or 3D

orbit.describe: a slow orbit around the subject, as a flat 2D rotation

dolly.describe: a slow sideways glide across the frame

visual.figure: {subject}; the figure is {name}, drawn in the same simple illustration style, not a photograph: recognisable only by {likeness}
visual.silhouette: {subject}; the figure as a simple flat silhouette: {silhouette}
visual.avoid: photorealistic, photograph, live action, 3D render, CGI, glossy plastic, realistic skin texture, text, letters, logos, watermarks, deformed faces, extra limbs, neon, strobing, generic stock scenery the scene does not ask for
visual.morph_avoid: photorealistic, photograph, live action, 3D render, CGI, text, letters, logos, watermarks, deformed faces, extra limbs, strobing or rapid full-frame flashing, camera cuts to unrelated footage

tone.darker: A little darker and calmer than before: softer light, fewer highlights.
tone.lighter: A little more light than before: the focal point clearly lit.
tone.richer: A little more colour than before in the focal point, still within the palette.

frame: an open frame with space around the focal point
a wide open frame, the focal point inviting a closer look
a very open frame, the focal point bright in a spacious scene
light: a little warm light on the focal point
warm light gathering on the focal point
warm light opening across the scene
motion: the scene opens out and lifts
lean_in.framing: an open, spacious frame with the subject surrounded by space

frame: a tight frame, the edges closing in
a close, enclosed frame around the focal point
light: firm cool light on the focal point
hard cool light, the edges in shadow
motion: the space draws toward the focal point
the frame closes steadily on the focal point
brace.framing: a tight, enclosed frame with walls or shadow close around the subject

frame: the focal point set a little further off
the focal point receding into the distance
the focal point small and far away
light: muted cool light, the colour fading
motion: the space slips away from the focal point
recoil.framing: a receding frame with the subject small and distant

frame: an opening frame, the horizon returning
a wide, calm frame with the surroundings in view
settle.framing: a level, balanced frame with visible surroundings

shifts.inward: the space folds gently inward toward the next focal point
shifts.outward: the frame opens out onto the next focal point
shifts.sideways: the scene flows sideways into the next

speeds.swift: swiftly but smoothly, without a cut

field.warmer: Warmer light than before, no cold cast.
field.cooler: Cooler light than before, no warm cast.

visual.reference_note: The attached photographs are only for identity and shape: hairline, glasses, build, clothing, the outline of a building or object. Never copy their photographic detail, skin texture, lighting or realism: redraw everything in the illustration style described.
visual.keyframe_template: {frame} illustration, full bleed, no borders. Main scene: {subject}, in {setting}. Composition: {composition}; {field_frame}. Key elements: {key_elements}. Colour and light: {light_and_colour}; {field_light}. Drawn as: {style}. {texture}. {lighting}. Avoid: {avoid}.
visual.segment_template: One continuous {orientation} 2D animated illustration. It opens exactly on {subject} in {setting}, held for a beat with {camera}; {motion}; {field_motion}. Then the transformation: {shift}, and {morph_bridge} becomes the next scene. {morph}. It lands exactly on {next_subject} in {next_setting} and holds still. Drawn as: {style}. {texture}. Avoid: {avoid}.
visual.final_segment_template: One continuous {orientation} shot with no cuts. {subject} in {setting}, with {camera}; {motion}; {field_motion}. The picture slowly settles and fades. {morph}. Drawn as: {style}. {texture}. Avoid: {avoid}.

writing.voice: Clear, curious and fair: plain words that explain, a little warmth, no hype.

rhythm.source: A general guide for spoken explainers. Replace it with `analyse-narration` on a narrator you admire.

voice.direction: Clear, warm and curious, like explaining something fascinating to a friend.
voice.audition_text: The first bridge across the river took eleven years to build. It lasted four. What went wrong is a story about money, pride, and one missing bolt.
voice.audition_direction: A clear, warm narrator explaining something fascinating: brisk through context, slower on the key line, never theatrical.

music.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. A light, curious underscore for a narrated explainer: a soft steady pulse, warm pads, a few gentle plucked notes, slowly evolving, never busy. Sits quietly under a voice; no sudden swells or hits.
variations: Voice it with warm synth pads and soft plucks.
Voice it with gentle piano and light strings.
Voice it with mellow mallets and a soft bass.
Voice it with airy guitar harmonics and a low drone.
